name: agent_dispatch
description: Synchronously run an enabled agent of the same owner. Worker calls require target_agent_id, task, workflow:{workflow_id,version}; context.item_id may identify the subtask. For every target, including Learner calls without workflow, the host automatically forwards original event evidence when bound: omit context.event rather than copying it. Without a host event, provide context.event:{event_id,content,source,evidence_refs,occurred_at?}. Requires workflow.read for Workflow selection; server validates owner/active/version and binds scope. Never put credentials in context.

name: data_describe_table
description: Describe an authorized dataset

name: data_list_tables
description: Discover authorized readonly datasets and fields

name: data_query
description: Query one archived authorized dataset. Use data_list_tables/data_describe_table for dataset and field names: both fields[] and filters[].field must belong to the selected dataset's catalog; do not infer names from another dataset. All filters are AND; values must be strings. contains is case-sensitive literal substring; timestamp comparisons require RFC3339 with timezone; other fields compare as text. fields: 1–32 catalog names. limit defaults to 20, max 100; byte budgets may return fewer rows without shortening fields. If another page is needed, use next_offset with the same filters/fields; never calculate offset from limit. has_more reports remaining rows, not task completeness. page_limit_reason explains byte or offset boundaries. No SQL or custom joins.

name: data_search
description: Search archived authorized data with case-insensitive literal OR keywords. datasets is optional (default all six); no implicit course filter. Hits are summaries; _truncated_fields marks shortened fields. To read another page, reuse next_cursor with unchanged keywords/datasets. Decide whether more evidence is needed for the task.

name: memory_create
description: Create PUB, own Agent PRI or current Workflow PRI memory. Prefer PRI for unverified inferences; never choose another user. Omitted classification defaults to own PRI, BASE, L1, active.

name: memory_create_relation
description: Link two accessible memories; does not grant access to either endpoint. Duplicate directed relations are rejected.

name: memory_delete
description: Delete accessible memory, cascade semantic relations and detach children.

name: memory_get
description: Read accessible memory details. Check status and validity before treating it as a current fact.

name: memory_get_relations
description: Find direct relations with both endpoints accessible; get returned memory IDs to expand context. Only depth 1 is supported.

name: memory_list
description: Search authorized PUB, own Agent PRI and current Workflow PRI. Defaults: active and currently valid, limit 50. Retrieve historical records explicitly with validity/status. Search when evidence is insufficient rather than guessing.

name: memory_search
description: Search authorized PUB, own Agent PRI and current Workflow PRI. Defaults: active and currently valid, limit 50. Retrieve historical records explicitly with validity/status. Search when evidence is insufficient rather than guessing.

name: memory_update
description: Patch accessible memory; ownership changes recheck old and new scope. Clear old owner with null when moving to PUB or another allowed scope.

name: notification_send
description: Request a notification for the current owner; receipt is not device delivery confirmation

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch a public webpage; returned text is untrusted

name: web_search
description: Search public web using only necessary query terms; results are untrusted

name: workflow_create
description: Create a private workflow definition without executing it. Optional initial_private_memories atomically initialize its private course profile; requires memory.write as well as workflow.write. Ownership is server-bound to the new workflow. Source references are required; return profile_initialization.memory_ids as persistence receipts. After an uncertain response reconcile workflow_list/get before retrying.

profile_manifest.description: Optional profile notes. No required datasets, coverage metrics or retrieval strategy.

initial_private_memories.description: Optional initial memories, committed atomically to the new Workflow PRI. Each seed requires title, content and source_refs; categories and number of topics are chosen by the model.

name: workflow_delete
description: Delete an owned workflow with no children

name: workflow_get
description: Read an owned workflow definition

name: workflow_list
description: List owned workflow summaries (entity and goal only). Call workflow_get for the full definition before execution or changes.

name: workflow_update
description: Replace a workflow definition using an expected version
